source: Koepsell, D. R., The Recognition Layer: A Generative Typology of Structural Contradiction for Recognition-Constituted Domains (working draft), §6-§8.

loci.label: Artifact body
loci.definition: The definitional and assertional content of the artifact itself, considered apart from any chain link. Present in every system, including systems with no chain of their own.
loci.rationale: Implementation decision, not in the paper's seven-link chain. §8.3 row 1 requires Strata A, B and C to be able to fire in a reference ontology, which by hypothesis performs no link. Without a locus that is present unconditionally, the ungated strata would have nothing to be indexed to in an act-empty system and the A/B/C columns of Table 10 could not be constant. Every A/B/C primitive is well-formed here; no D primitive is.

loci.label: Source of authority
loci.definition: The source entitled to fix the criteria.

loci.label: Criteria
loci.definition: The substantive standard applied in the recognition act.

loci.label: Assessor in role
loci.definition: The agent licensed by the authority to apply the criteria.

loci.label: Presenting facts
loci.definition: The state of affairs to which the criteria are applied.

loci.label: Recognition act
loci.definition: The act in which criteria are applied to facts and a status is conferred.

loci.label: Effects
loci.definition: The consequences following from the conferral.

loci.label: Remedy
loci.definition: The pathway, where the system provides one, by which a conferral can be revisited.

strata.label: Model-theoretic
strata.definition: Failures of a theory relative to its models.

strata.label: Definitional
strata.definition: Failures in how terms are defined and grounded, independent of domain content.

strata.label: Meta-ontological
strata.definition: Failures of typing and grounding relative to an upper ontology.

strata.label: Pragmatic
strata.definition: Failures available only where there are acts.

primitives.name: Inconsistency
primitives.definition: The theory admits no model; locally, a sentence and its negation are both derivable. Variants: assertional, deontic, analytic.
primitives.formal_signature: O |= ⊥ globally; locally, jointly unsatisfiable assertions over one locus
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Jointly unsatisfiable assertions can be made about any locus, including presenting facts.

primitives.name: Term Incoherence
primitives.definition: The theory is satisfiable but some term is not: a class equivalent to the empty class.
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Requires a defined term whose satisfaction conditions can empty out. Presenting facts are asserted, not defined.

primitives.name: Indeterminacy
primitives.definition: Underconstraint: unintended models admitted, or membership undecided where practice requires a decision.
primitives.formal_signature: Intended and admitted models diverge; borderline membership underivable
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Underconstraint is available wherever anything is specified at all.

primitives.name: Circularity
primitives.definition: Non-wellfounded definition or grounding: a term's conditions depend transitively on the term itself, or a grounding order is inverted. The temporal case is inversion projected into time.
primitives.formal_signature: A cycle in the definition dependency graph, or inversion of a required grounding order
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Requires a definition or grounding order. Presenting facts supply neither.

primitives.name: Equivocation
primitives.definition: One item playing incompatible roles: a term, condition, or occupant doing double duty under conflicting demands.
primitives.formal_signature: One element bound to two roles with conflicting satisfaction conditions
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Double duty is available at every locus, including facts, where one described state of affairs can be bound to two incompatible characterizations.

primitives.name: Residual Definition
primitives.definition: A term defined only by complement: membership fixed negatively, as what remains once the positive categories are exhausted.
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Well-formed wherever a positive differentia is owed. An authority is designated rather than defined by complement; facts are asserted; the act is performed.

primitives.name: Category Violation
primitives.definition: An entity forced under disjoint upper-ontological categories: the formalized category mistake.
primitives.formal_signature: a : C and a : D, C and D disjoint at the upper level
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Anything typed at all can be mistyped.
precedents: BFO disjointness axioms (Arp, Smith, and Spear 2015)

primitives.name: Level Confusion
primitives.definition: Representational levels conflated: a universal treated as a particular, a class as an instance, use as mention.
primitives.formal_signature: One element occupying two levels whose disciplines conflict
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Level conflation is available wherever there is representation.

primitives.name: Dependence Violation
primitives.definition: A dependent entity posited without its bearer, or a grounding link severed, including where one direction of a mutual dependence is enforced and the other denied.
primitives.formal_signature: A specifically dependent continuant without a bearer
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Requires a dependent entity and a bearer relation. Presenting facts are the bearer side, not the dependent side.
precedents: Husserl on foundation, as developed by Smith

primitives.name: Falsification
primitives.definition: Assertion and world mismatched: triggering conditions fabricated, suppressed, or misrepresented. The artifact is coherent; its contact with reality is corrupted.
primitives.formal_signature: An asserted triggering condition with no worldly truthmaker
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Requires something asserted about the world. Authority, criteria and role are conferred rather than asserted.
precedents: the law of evidence as an institutionalized detection apparatus
primitives.operationalization_note: Not operationalized and will not be (paper §13): detection requires world-facing ground truth about whether asserted triggering conditions obtained.

primitives.name: Performative Self-Defeat
primitives.definition: An act whose success conditions are undermined by its own performance: a norm whose compliance conditions preclude compliance.
primitives.formal_signature: Satisfying the act's content entails failure of its success conditions
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Requires an act with success conditions, or a norm stating compliance conditions.
precedents: Apel and Habermas on performative contradiction
primitives.operationalization_note: Low recall by construction (paper §13): only the text-internal case is implemented.

primitives.name: Modal Clash
primitives.definition: A capacity present in structure but blocked in practice: possible according to the artifact, unrealizable in the institution implementing it. (de jure / de facto)
primitives.well_formedness_rationale: Requires a capacity. Presenting facts confer none.
precedents: Pound (1910) on law in books versus law in action
primitives.operationalization_note: Primary detector of the registered design (paper §10.1): a capacity conferred in the text with no procedural pathway specified for invoking it.

gating_rule.statement: Strata A, B and C are ungated: their preconditions are rules, definitions and top-level kinds, all of which live inside the artifact. Stratum D is gated three ways by the status of the link at which the crossing sits.
gating_rule.note: For ungated strata, 'absent' yields no_locus rather than cannot_fire or not_applicable. Three facts are kept apart. not_applicable is a kernel-level fact: the crossing is not well-formed, so the coordinate does not exist in any system. no_locus is a system-level fact: the crossing is well-formed and this system simply has no link there, so the failure it names relocates to the artifact body rather than vanishing. cannot_fire says the link exists and the primitive is barred at it. The artifact pseudo-locus is always present, so A, B and C always have somewhere to fire.

named_types.label: Disjointness / Overlap Failure
named_types.reading: Criteria → Recognition: intended disjointness left unasserted, so jointly satisfiable models survive. The signature of artifactual comorbidity.

named_types.label: Criterion Circularity
named_types.reading: A category's defining conditions depend transitively on the category itself.

named_types.label: Threshold / Polythetic Incoherence
named_types.reading: A disjunctive family without shared essence; membership underconstrained.

named_types.label: Criterion Double-Duty
named_types.reading: One condition bound to conflicting inclusion and exclusion roles.

named_types.label: Recognition Failure
named_types.reading: Criteria → Recognition: the diagnostic act cannot track the criteria; grounding severed.

named_types.label: Type Contradiction
named_types.reading: Upper level: an entity forced under disjoint BFO categories.

fuller_1964.description: Fuller's eight desiderata located in the product for a legal order (paper §7.4 Table 9). Included as a fixture: the generator does not use it, and the test suite checks that every PRIMARY coordinate below is a well-formed crossing of the generated legal grid. Where Table 9 writes an arrow ('Criteria -> Effects'), the first element is the locus of the crossing and the second is recorded here as `manifests_at`: where the failure shows up, not a second crossing. That reading is forced by the tables themselves. Table 9 places 'Possibility of compliance' at K-D2 with the arrow running to Effects, while Table 7 marks K-D2 as not well-formed at Effects. Read as a manifestation pointer the two tables agree; read as a second crossing they do not. The alternative resolution is to make K-D2 well-formed at Effects, which would change the legal grid from 70 to 71 well-formed cells. This is an open question for the author, recorded rather than silently resolved.

admission_criteria.description: Conditions under which a candidate contradiction type is admitted to a domain typology (paper §7.2).
criteria: locus_indexed: the type is stated at a determinate (primitive, locus) coordinate
distinguishable: model-theoretically distinguishable from every existing type in both directions
non_derivable: not derivable from existing types, except where a compound carries emergent diagnostic value

bfo.note: Every IRI below is verified against the upstream ontologies by tools/check_bfo.py. The label is part of the claim: referring to the right IRI under the wrong description is how a module ends up wired backwards while passing every structural check.

local_terms.prescribes: Relates a directive information entity to the occurrent or realizable entity whose occurrence it directs. IAO has no relation of this shape. If one is adopted upstream, replace it and regenerate.
local_terms.conferredBy: Relates a role to the process in which it came to be borne.
local_terms.firingValue: Annotation. A rate claim, not an axiom about the world.
local_terms.detectionInstrument: Annotation. Which instrument, if any, operationalises the primitive.
local_terms.operationalized: Annotation. Whether the primitive is operationalised in this release.

decisions.decision: The twelve primitives are classes, not individuals.
decisions.rationale: Their instances are particular contradictions in particular artifacts. Each class carries an Aristotelian definition and a definition source.

decisions.decision: A contradiction is an information content entity, a continuant part of the artifact bearing it.
decisions.rationale: Not a quality: two printings of one code carry the same contradiction, so the entity is generically dependent rather than inhering in a material bearer.

decisions.decision: A contradiction at the criteria locus is one that is part of a criteria specification. No locus-indexing relation, no crossing individuals.
decisions.rationale: BFO_0000050 already does the work. Minting a relation or an individual would add machinery the mereology supplies for free.

decisions.decision: An artifact either has a specification part of a given kind or it does not. An absent link MUST NOT be represented by an individual carrying a status of 'absent'.
decisions.rationale: Such an individual posits an entity in order to deny that it exists.

decisions.decision: A conferred status is a role inhering in the bearer together with a declaration about it.
decisions.rationale: The single-part alternatives are each expressively inadequate. A role alone asserts that something inheres in the bearer; a generically dependent continuant alone gives no bearer for the assertion to be made or withheld about. Only the two-part model can represent a system that records and mandates a status while declining to assert that anything inheres in anyone, which is WHO's stated position on ICD-11 Chapter 26.

decisions.decision: Firing values are annotations, not axioms.
decisions.rationale: A rate is not something the world contains, and the middle value of the gate is an empirical claim that could turn out false without anything in the ontology being wrong.
